signup.password-dont-match: Confirmation password must be the same of password.
signup.terms-not-accepted: You must accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to register.

reset.token-not-found: Invalid or expired token, please try again.
reset.email-sent: An email with a link was sent, click to reset password.
reset.success: Password changed, login with the new password.

delete.email-sent: A confirmation email has been sent. Click the link to confirm account deletion.
delete.token-not-found: Invalid or expired token, please try again.

reauth.no-password: This account has no password. Request a code by email instead.
reauth.method-unavailable: That way of confirming isn't available for this account.
reauth.wrong-code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.

two-factor.setup-not-started: Start setup for this method before confirming a code.
two-factor.wrong-code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
two-factor.code-required: Enter a code from one of your armed methods, or a backup code, to change your second factors.
two-factor.not-enabled: Two-factor authentication isn't enabled on this account.
two-factor.unknown-method: That two-factor method isn't available on this deployment.
two-factor.not-delivered: That method doesn't send codes — read it off your device instead.
two-factor.email-unverified: Confirm your email address before using it as a second factor.
two-factor.resend-too-soon: A code was just sent. Wait a moment before asking for another.
two-factor.method-added: That second factor is now armed.
two-factor.method-removed: That second factor has been removed.
two-factor.backup-codes-regenerated: Your backup codes have been regenerated. The old ones no longer work.
two-factor.locked: Too many wrong codes. Two-factor checks on this account are paused for a while; try again later.
two-factor.challenge-invalid: This login attempt has expired. Please sign in again.

export.requested: Export requested. We will email you a link when it is ready.

verify.email-sent: A verification email has been sent, click the link to confirm your address.
verify.resend-too-soon: A verification email was just sent. Please wait a moment before asking for another.
verify.token-not-found: Invalid or expired token, please try again.

email-change.too-soon: An email change was just requested. Please wait a moment before requesting another.
email-change.token-not-found: Invalid or expired token, please try again.
email-change.undone: The email change was undone and every device was signed out.
email-change.cancelled: The pending email change was cancelled.
email-change.resent: A new confirmation link was sent to the new address.
email-change.nothing-pending: There is no pending email change.

verify-request.subject: Confirm your email address
verify-request.intro: Please confirm that this email address is yours.
verify-request.ignore: If you did not create this account, you can safely ignore this email.

reset-request.subject: Password reset
reset-request.intro: We received a request to reset your password.
reset-request.ignore: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

setup-request.subject: Set up your account
setup-request.intro: An administrator created an account for you. Choose a password to complete your registration.
setup-request.ignore: If you weren't expecting this, contact whoever manages this site.

reset-confirm.subject: Your password was changed
reset-confirm.providers: These sign-in methods are still connected to your account: {{providers}}. A password reset does not disconnect them; if you do not recognise one, remove it from your profile.
reset-confirm.providers-none: No Google or GitHub sign-in is connected to your account.

delete-request.subject: Confirm account deletion
delete-request.intro: We received a request to permanently delete your account.
delete-request.ignore: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

delete-confirm.subject: Your account has been deleted
delete-confirm.body: Your account has been permanently deleted.
delete-confirm.farewell: We're sorry to see you go. If this was a mistake, please contact support.

inactivity-warning.subject: Your account has been inactive
inactivity-warning.body: We haven't seen you sign in for a while. To keep your account, sign in within the next {{days}} days — after that it will be deactivated, and eventually permanently deleted.

export-ready.subject: Your data export is ready
export-ready.intro: The copy of your data you asked for is ready. Sign in and open this link to download it:
export-ready.expiry: The file is kept for {{days}} days, then deleted.
export-ready.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, change your password and sign out everywhere.

two-factor-code.subject: Your sign-in code
two-factor-code.intro: Here is the code to finish signing in:
two-factor-code.ignore: If you weren't signing in, ignore this email and change your password.

email-change-notice.subject: Your email address is changing
email-change-notice.body: Someone asked to change the email address on this account to {{newEmail}}. If this was you, no action is needed — it takes effect once the new address is confirmed. If it wasn't, undo the change with the link below: it works for 7 days, even after the new address is confirmed, and signs every device out.

two-factor-changed.subject: Your two-factor settings changed
two-factor-changed.body-enrolled: A second sign-in step ({{method}}) was added or replaced on your account.
two-factor-changed.body-removed: The second sign-in step ({{method}}) was removed from your account.
two-factor-changed.body-disabled: Two-factor authentication was turned off on your account.
two-factor-changed.advice: If this was not you, change your password and sign out everywhere now.

two-factor-locked.subject: Your two-factor checks are locked
two-factor-locked.body: Too many wrong two-factor codes were entered on your account, so code checks are paused for {{minutes}} minutes.
two-factor-locked.advice: If this was not you, someone knows your password: change it now. Resetting your password also lifts the lock.

reauth-code.subject: Your confirmation code
reauth-code.intro: Here is the code to confirm it's you:
reauth-code.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email and change your password.

oauth.invalid-state: This sign-in attempt has expired. Please try again.
oauth.invalid-verifier: This sign-in attempt has expired. Please try again.
oauth.link-not-found: That sign-in method is not connected to your account.
